description: Read one of the user's OWN message conversations by thread_id, including its messages (marks incoming messages read). Only threads the authenticated user participates in are returned.

thread_id.description: Conversation id (a UUID), taken from list_conversations. Example: "3f6c2a1e-8b4d-4c7a-9e21-5d0f7a6b1c34".

name: get_conversation
